_about: Shared vectors for the humanize path planner: sdk/python/clearcote/_motion.py plan_move/plan_drag/shape_traits, sdk/node/src/motion.ts and sdk/dotnet/src/Clearcote/Motion.cs must plan these exact paths (abs tolerance 1e-6 px / ms; shape traits 1e-12) from makePersona(persona) and mulberry32(rng). Generated by sdk/python/tests/gen_motion_vectors.py. Randomness rule (SC 232 PLAN.md): the seed fixes persona TRAITS only; every per-action draw pinned here (paths, drags, ambient, timings, wheel_anchor points) is drawn from the explicit mulberry32(rng) a test passes, never from the persona seed. The SDKs keep per-action draws unseeded at run time.
